title: bupleurum divaricatum f. nanum
intro: Bupleurum divaricatum f. nanum, commonly known as Dwarf Hare's Ear, is a plant species belonging to the family Apiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving liver function, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Dwarf Hare's Ear include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and hepatoprotective properties, which contribute to its potential in treating conditions such as liver disease and fever. The bioactive constituents of Bupleurum divaricatum f. nanum include saikosaponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
